verdict.rationale: Kling's own docs describe multi-shot storyboarding with per-shot camera control covering pan, tilt, zoom, dolly and handheld, so creators can choose camera moves rather than accepting the model's default motion. The evidence is a single first-party line. Missing for 10: explicit orbit and static/locked-camera options, in-depth documentation of how camera moves are specified, independent or hands-on corroboration.
